svg.title: F-09 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-09 Monitor the system and carry out a minimal risk manoeuvre. M01 No function: A fault is not detected, or no manoeuvre follows; the vehicle keeps driving without control (H-07). M02 Stops functioning: The manoeuvre is abandoned midway; same as no function (H-07, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: An emergency stop without a fault; hard braking for nothing (H-03). M04 Function stuck: Monitor stuck at no fault; as M01 (H-07, rated as M01). M05 Excessive function: An emergency stop where a comfortable one was enough; as M03 (H-03, rated as M03). M06 Partial function: A manoeuvre too weak to stop the vehicle in time; bounded by M01 (H-07, rated as M01). M07 Functions early: An emergency stop before the fault is confirmed; as M03 (H-03, rated as M03). M08 Functions late: The manoeuvre starts late; as M11 (H-07, rated as M11). M09 Applies too short: The hold after the stop is released too early; the vehicle moves off (H-05). M11 Delayed: Detection or manoeuvre latency beyond specification; the vehicle drives on a fault for too long (H-07). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Manoeuvre starts and stops repeatedly; each start acts as M03 (H-03, rated as M03).
svg.text: F-09 Monitor the system and carry out a minimal risk manoeuvre: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-09): the 11 safety-related guide words, 4 rated and 7 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
